name: pi-chat-vscode
description: Work with Pi coding sessions from a VS Code sidebar.

commands.title: Pi Chat: Open New Chat Beside Active Editor
Pi Chat: Choose Pi Configuration Folder
Pi Chat: Manage Pi Runtime Environment Variables
Pi Chat: Export Redacted Diagnostic Report
Pi Chat: Open Local Diagnostic Log

piChat.agentDir.description: Use this Pi configuration folder for models, credentials, resources, and sessions. Empty uses Pi's default or PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR. Restart the Pi runtime after editing this setting.

enumDescriptions: Keep the PI_OFFLINE environment setting inherited by the Pi worker.
Set PI_OFFLINE=1 to disable automatic Pi startup network operations.
Remove PI_OFFLINE from the Pi worker environment and allow startup network operations.
piChat.offlineMode.description: Choose Pi's startup network behavior. Offline mode does not block model API requests. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

enumDescriptions: Prefer extension dialogs and the chat's built-in controls.
Prefer extension-provided terminal components, rendered as safe text cards in the chat.
piChat.extensionUiMode.description: Choose which Pi extension UI mode extensions see. Changes apply after restarting the Pi runtime.

enumDescriptions: Show extension status values in the chat footer.
Show extension status values in the VS Code status bar.
Show extension status values in both places.
Do not display extension status values.
piChat.extensionStatus.display.description: Choose where Pi extensions can display their status values.

piChat.extensionStatus.keys.description: Limit displayed Pi extension status values to these exact keys. An empty list displays every key.

piChat.context.followSelection.description: Include the active editor selection as a file and line reference when you send a message.

piChat.context.followActiveFile.description: Include the active editor file as a reference with each message when there is no selection.

piChat.context.includeDiagnostics.description: Include diagnostics from the active workspace file with each message.

piChat.context.includeGitStatus.description: Include the active workspace Git branch and changed file names with each message.

piChat.context.disableFiles.description: Prevent Pi from loading configured or workspace instruction files such as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.prompts.systemPromptText.description: Replace Pi's system prompt with this text. If set, it takes precedence over the system prompt file. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.prompts.systemPromptFile.description: Replace Pi's system prompt with a UTF-8 file path, relative to the workspace or absolute. Ignored when systemPromptText is set. Files are limited to 1 MiB. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.prompts.appendSystemPromptText.description: Append this text after Pi's configured system prompt and discovered append prompt files. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.prompts.appendSystemPromptFiles.description: Append UTF-8 prompt files after Pi's configured instructions. Paths are relative to the workspace or absolute; each file is limited to 1 MiB. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.additionalExtensionPath.description: Load additional local Pi extension files or directories. Workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted. Package sources are managed through Pi package controls. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.additionalSkillPaths.description: Load additional local Pi skill files or directories. Paths are relative to the workspace or absolute. Workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.additionalPromptTemplat.description: Load additional local Pi prompt-template files or directories. Paths are relative to the workspace or absolute. Workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.additionalThemePaths.description: Load additional local Pi theme files or directories for Pi extension renderers. Paths are relative to the workspace or absolute. Workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.disableExtensionDiscove.description: Stop Pi from discovering configured extensions automatically; explicitly listed additional extension paths and the chat's built-in integrations remain enabled. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.disableSkillDiscovery.description: Stop Pi from discovering configured skills automatically; explicitly listed additional skill paths remain enabled. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.disablePromptTemplateDi.description: Stop Pi from discovering configured prompt templates automatically; explicitly listed additional prompt-template paths remain enabled. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.resources.disableThemeDiscovery.description: Stop Pi from discovering configured themes automatically; explicitly listed additional theme paths remain enabled. This does not change the VS Code chat appearance. Restart the Pi runtime after changing this setting.

piChat.sessions.autoName.description: Name an unnamed Pi session from its first non-command prompt without making an extra provider request.

piChat.sessions.openLatestOnStart.description: Open the most recently updated Pi session for this workspace when the chat view starts. Pi project resources remain subject to the existing trust prompt.

piChat.sessions.groupRunning.description: Show running Pi sessions in a separate group at the top of session history.

piChat.sessions.sortOrder.description: Sort Pi session history manually, by recent activity, or by title. Pinned sessions stay at the top.

enumDescriptions: Queue messages to send after the current turn.
Send messages as steering input during the current turn.
piChat.queue.defaultAction.description: Choose the default action for messages sent while Pi is working. The composer toggle can switch it for the current chat.

piChat.composer.promptHistory.description: Remember recent prompts locally in the chat composer for Arrow Up and Arrow Down. Disabling this clears the webview's saved prompt history; Pi session transcripts and saved drafts are unchanged.

piChat.mcp.enabled.description: Connect enabled servers from Pi MCP configuration after an explicit confirmation.

piChat.tools.defaultToolNames.description: Choose the default tools for new Pi chats. Use the single value * to keep Pi's configured defaults, an empty list for no tools, or registered tool names for a custom set.

piChat.transcript.expandSuccessfulToolCa.description: Open successful tool cards by default in the Pi Chat transcript. Errors remain expanded.

piChat.appearance.userMessagesOnRight.description: Align your messages to the right side of the Pi Chat transcript.

piChat.appearance.tintUserMessages.description: Give your Pi Chat messages a subtle accent tint.

piChat.appearance.strongerContrast.description: Increase contrast for secondary text and separators in Pi Chat.

piChat.appearance.fontSize.description: Set the Pi Chat base font size in pixels. Use 0 to follow VS Code; explicit values from 10 to 24 are applied.

piChat.appearance.smoothScrolling.description: Use smooth scrolling when navigating the Pi Chat transcript.

piChat.appearance.spacing.description: Set vertical spacing between Pi Chat transcript messages.

piChat.appearance.showSeparators.description: Show a divider between a finished assistant turn and the next user message.

piChat.models.autoRefresh.description: Refresh configured model catalogs when the Pi runtime starts. This can contact provider endpoints and run configured API-key commands; it is skipped in Pi offline mode.

piChat.notifications.runFinished.description: Show a VS Code notification when a Pi run finishes while the chat view is hidden.

piChat.notifications.inputRequired.description: Show a VS Code notification when a Pi extension asks for input while the chat view is hidden.

piChat.notifications.sound.description: Play a brief local tone when Pi finishes a run or asks for input while the chat view is hidden.

piChat.notifications.hookCommand.description: Optional machine-scoped command to run for selected Pi Chat notification events. It runs with your OS account permissions after confirmation; use only a command or script you trust. Workspace values are ignored and Pi credentials are not forwarded.

piChat.notifications.hookEvents.description: Choose which events run piChat.notifications.hookCommand. Events are ignored while the command is empty.

scripts.compile: npm run compile:extension && npm run compile:worker && npm run compile:webview && npm run compile:draft-store
scripts.smoke:shell-command: esbuild src/shell-command.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/shell-command.cjs && esbuild src/shell-command-queue.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/shell-command-queue.cjs && node scripts/smoke-shell-command.mjs
